notes.title: Fallalypse Universe Unites
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33900554/2ef560938d160abfcce8f866867bec92e6078187.jpg

We decided to conduct a small experiment by combining two games from the same Fallalypse Universe. Now players who buy Memorial Park and Disconnect when traveling around the world of Disconnect may come across the cemetery with their grave created in Memorial Park. 

It seems to us that this introduces some interesting and unusual context into Disconnect and in general into the game Universe of Fallalypse. So in this destroyed world there's a random chance that you can get to the old graveyard with the grave created by you in Memorial Park.

To sum up:

1. Buy both games:

 https://store.steampowered.com/app/978610
 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1051630

2. Travel across the game world of Disconnect. And you can randomly find a graveyard location. There you can gather resources and visit your own grave from Memorial Park.https://store.steampowered.com/app/978610
